map.输入木材含水率、节子尺寸等参数，按GB/T 153标准判定锯材质量等级: Enter wood moisture content, knot dimensions and other parameters to judge the sawn-timber quality grade by standard GB/T 153
map.锯材等级判定（GB/T 153 与 GB/T 4817）：按含水率、节子尺寸与个: Sawn-timber grade judgment (GB/T 153 and GB/T 4817): grade by moisture content, knot size and count, curvature, cracks, etc. — knot max-size-to-face-width ratio, knots per meter, and curvature (bow height ÷ length × 100%) beyond limit downgrade the grade; moisture over limit must be re-dried and re-inspected.
map.进货验收时按含水率、节子尺寸与数量、弯曲度判定锯材等级，作为结算与分拣依据。: At incoming acceptance, judge sawn-timber grade by moisture, knot size/count and curvature as the basis for settlement and sorting.
map.按针叶树（GB/T 153）与阔叶树（GB/T 4817）分别判定，避免标准混用: Judge softwood (GB/T 153) and hardwood (GB/T 4817) separately to avoid mixing standards.
map.加工前先分级，把特等/一等材用在外观件，低等材用在隐蔽或受力次要部位。: Pre-process grading: use special/first-class timber for visible parts, lower-class for concealed or secondary-load parts.
map.针叶树（GB/T 153）、含水率 12%（达标区间 8–18%）、最大节子 3: Softwood (GB/T 153), moisture 12% (pass range 8–18%), max knot 30 mm, board width 200 mm → knot-diameter ratio 15.0%, knots per meter 2, curvature 2 mm/m → meets "knot ratio ≤15% and knots/m ≤2 and curvature ≤2 and moisture pass" → judged Special grade. If max knot rises to 45 mm (22.5%), rest unchanged → downgraded to First grade; if moisture rises to 20% → moisture fails, check whether it meets second-class 6–22% range to set grade.
map.两个标准有什么区别？: What is the difference between the two standards?
map.针叶树锯材按 GB/T 153、阔叶树锯材按 GB/T 4817 判定，分等指标: Softwood sawn timber judged by GB/T 153, hardwood by GB/T 4817; the thresholds of grading indicators (knot ratio, knots per meter, curvature, moisture) differ. After selecting the wood species, the tool auto-switches the corresponding standard.
map.用含水率测定仪在板材端面以内 30 cm 处取多点平均，或用烘干法。表面潮湿或刚: Use a moisture meter averaging multiple points within 30 cm from the board end, or the oven-dry method. Boards that are surface-wet or just rained read high; let them equilibrate before measuring.
map.针叶树锯材按GB/T 153评定，阔叶树锯材按GB/T 4817评定: Softwood sawn timber judged by GB/T 153, hardwood by GB/T 4817
map.含水率是关键指标：家具用材≤12%，建筑用材≤15%，室外用材≤18%: Moisture is the key indicator: furniture timber ≤12%, construction timber ≤15%, outdoor timber ≤18%
map.节子评定按最大节子尺寸与材宽之比分级，特等品≤15%: Knot grading by max knot size to board width ratio; Special grade ≤15%
map.弯曲度包括顺弯、横弯和翘弯，取最大值评定: Curvature includes bow, crook and cup; take the max for grading
map.木材应在含水率平衡后检测，避免干燥应力导致评定偏差: Wood should be inspected after moisture equilibration to avoid grading bias from drying stress
